name: engineering-tools
description: Developer workflows for change assessment, code simplification, commits, technical debt, and technical writing.

interface.shortDescription: Size work, simplify code, and improve engineering workflows.
interface.longDescription: Assess software-change complexity, simplify code during implementation or review, audit technical debt, prepare Conventional Commits, and write clear technical documentation.
defaultPrompt: Assess this software change's implementation complexity and recommend the next step.
Simplify this code or review it for unnecessary complexity while preserving behavior.
Audit this codebase for actionable technical debt.
Prepare a Conventional Commit from the staged changes.
Write or review this technical document for purpose, clarity, and precision.
